what: S6 follow-up: scope-args: --files needs a value refused every file because done tickets own them (one writer per file); only a hand edit of the ledger could move ownership. T-0164 (claude lane, $0.50) rewired the route to S6 modules but its e2e assumed the dev transport under next start (NODE_ENV=production disables it), so rows ended failed/resend_api_key_missing until a stub Resend and a guarded RESEND_BASE_URL were added by hand. T-0165, built the step before, imported the S5 sender instead of the S6 modules, and S6 had three overlapping senders/status helpers.
rule: Integration tickets must be able to take over files from done tickets (or the original ticket must own all files on the path); a worker that adds an e2e must run it; deletions of superseded modules must be a ticket output; one capability = one owner module per stage.
fix: tickets --files: allow transferring a file from a done ticket with --yes and a note; integrate: propagate declared deletions; runner: run the ticket's e2e (e2e/*.spec.ts) in verify with the project's e2e command; scope split: integration tickets list the superseded modules to delete.
